facts.intro: A sturdy hand crank protrudes from the wall, ready for a firm grip.
facts.reveal: Turning the crank rotates the attached drum, which has a groove for the steel cable.
facts.step1: The cable is wound onto the drum, pulling the door upward as the drum turns.
facts.step2: Each rotation lifts the door a little higher, the drum’s friction keeping the cable from slipping.
facts.step3: When the door reaches the top, the drum stops turning and the cable rests neatly on the drum.
facts.step4: Releasing the crank lets the door stay in place, held by the tension in the cable.
facts.hold: If you keep the crank turned, the drum continues winding and the door keeps rising.
facts.payoff: The whole system lifts the heavy garage door smoothly with only manual effort.
